definitions.explanation: The hand on the left side of the body.
The left side when giving directions or describing locations.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}で{字|じ}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: I write with my left hand.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}に{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: I'm holding the luggage in my left hand.

examples.japanese: まっすぐ{行|い}くと{左手|ひだりて}に{銀行|ぎんこう}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: If you go straight ahead, you'll see a bank on the left.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}を{怪我|けが}して、{箸|はし}が{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: I injured my left hand and can't use chopsticks.

notes:
READING NOTE:
{左手|ひだりて} has two readings:
・ひだりて — left hand (physical hand) or left side (in directions)
・さしゅ — literary reading, rarely used in modern Japanese

CONTRAST:
・{左手|ひだりて} — left hand / left side
・{右手|みぎて} — right hand / right side

For giving directions, {左手|ひだりて}に means "on your left": {左手|ひだりて}に{見|み}える (visible on the left).
